dynamic_boundaries: REPLEnvironment.execute executes the original test-provided Python source strings; these values are represented in original case logic and are not statically expanded as Python call edges.
MagicMock worker callbacks, pytest fixture lifecycle and imported third-party behavior are external/dynamic boundaries.
method: stdlib AST only; no imports, collection, evaluation or execution
qualification: This is a conservative static source graph for reachable direct calls resolved uniquely by AST and narrow local receiver/factory inference. It does not assert branch execution or runtime reachability; exact full source/config Git envelopes and native readset bind all possible code bytes.
